title: OneCoin  Dr.  Ruja Ignatova  in dubai

asr.full_text: Thank You Sadat. So I think I speak for all of us if I say that the last month actually surpassed our expectations. Where is the Finnish continued and we mined successfully with many of you here in January the 20th actually the first coins. Now in the meantime you have all seen we have mined over 140 coins, 40 million coins and you all see that there's already a big waiting list for mining the coin. Now I'm extremely happy to see so many new people joining us and I'm extremely happy to see you all mining the coin but of course you also see that the demand for the coin is currently higher than the supply and this is why our coin is having such a good development so I remember this sticker on the website and it was 2 and a half thousand members then I remember a big office party actually for 10,000 members by the way guys over there is a big part of the the Sofie office. Guys stand up! Show yourself, come yes! So then we were 50 000 people and I was extremely proud and I was very little because we all look at the counter but I think for my birthday in two weeks we'll be about 300 000 members I would be extremely happy for a project like this So the numbers, as I said about 150 million Coins mined 270,000 people joined the network And what is very, very important, guys of course we saw the key countries but it, very important, guys. As far as we saw, the key countries. But it is very important for crypto-currency to be present all over world. We are currently in about 184 countries on 5 continents, and this is what makes crypto-currency so powerful. Becuase I know that so many of you have difficulties with money transfers, do right we should do with style and i think they smiled a bit and said ah i don't know we're not sure and actually i was sure we would make it but i never ever expected to make it so fast now sebastian is always telling all my secrets so he said that there will be something new today happening. Why is OneCoin not listed on the ranks outside is because no exchange currently, except our internal exchange, has any transactions with OneCoin. So of course for us it was extremely important to change this. I had promised in Hong Kong that we would work on this and that we will talk to several exchanges and people and try to change this into a list of coins. Now, speaking to the big exchanges was not very easy, because our currency, as you know, is a currency for the everyday person, for everyone. It is not a special IT currency, it is not complicated everybody can join so what this means is that sometimes the sophisticated IT community looks down enough so when I asked the first top three exchanges if they would list us the answer was no we would like to watch this coin we would like to see but we cannot list the coin yet. So, what we did, actually we thought, why don't we find somebody who starts small as us. So, there's a small exchange we're starting up this week and they will list one coin. And I hope that many more will follow that So the exchange is called XcoinX and it will be also soon on the news and Whoever has a mobile phone now or internet access can check the website the website is X-coin X dot com and can see actually our coin already listed. So this is my surprise for you today So here we are this is the website as I said, it is a small startup exchange. They are starting now like us. They offer trading with Bitcoin and Bitcoin and they will be linked to our internal exchange where we trade the one coin. I think it is extremely, extremely important for us. As you say, my presentation was titled. Taking one coin to the next level. Now this is the next level. So now the majority of the people talking about us has been very positive. I think interest is growing a lot towards the coin... ... and we are very grateful guys, all of you here... ... that you are such ambassadors for this coin... ... and creating a very very positive reputation for us and for OneCoin. The more people know about us the more valuable actually the point becomes now this is one of my favorite pictures it does not look very exciting but to be very frank this is what it's all about Because cryptocurrency has an inherent value. You can of course trade the coin. I'll speak about trading the coin because you all know it. At one point of time we will start trading the coin. It might be even very very soon. I'll give you the timing. But you can trade the coin, speculate, you can invest. Currently all of you actually are investors who have coins because you wait for the value to grow. And by the way is somebody here in the audience who minded four tokens per coin? Congratulations, you at least doubled your investment. But the third thing and this is why I'm here, why I'm so passionate about cryptocurrency is to utilize the coin, to use it in your everyday life and this is what I want to excite you about, not only to take the coin, buy it, sell it, to help them, to hide it, but So the next question is how will this work? Of course, how will this work? First of all, we keep our promises. The trading will start. There will be buying opportunities from the mandatory accounts. There will be possibilities for you to use the coin to pay for packages. Wow. I have to say it again, I think. We can use the coins to pay new packages to buy gift cards. Wow. All this of course will be communicated over the next few weeks but what I want you to take away guys is the following. We have mined now about 7% of the coin. It is not a lot. Bitcoin has mined more than 50% of their coin. So we are still a baby coin even if our market capitalization is very big So we should do a baby corn that slowly needs to go And we're starting now with small steps To find our place in the big financial market We are getting a professional trading platform and now the world will start noticing us. I promise you this 2 million. We represent countries and continents I think we should go for 1.5 million. But I need your help I would say Sebastian, you are crazy. The results of the last 7 months speak for themselves. Thank you. So, moving one coin to the next level. What's in for us as a network? What are we focusing as a company to do for you? First of all, we would like to get all of you to get used to the coin and use the coin. We can start doing first steps in our network by date yourself a new product we'll get new store in the back of this where you can buy things for including gift codes we will start trading the points lonely and I know that some of you have amazing ideas about merchants a lot of content we are an amazing Network until end of the year we'll create the IT platform The Opportunity to Use one point and Merchant if you knew what I had my death as suggestions of people who would like to use this coin you would be extremely, extremely excited. So what we do is we will create all the necessary technical environment that everybody out there can use one coin in their online store or in their shops or whatever money, physical money is involved it can be replaced by cryptocurrency. And this, ladies and gentlemen, are actually my plans for the future. The one exchange will open on the 1st of June. The usual platforms, the usual colors. Make sure that you all will have a very easy way to understand this. And the starting price of the coin when we open will be 1 euro, 0.5 cents. Now, once again I would like to do a very very simple exercise with you I know that you, you know that I like numbers a lot So what we were doing in Finland the first time I presented a presentation of our Tycoon package that you can buy for 5000 euro you're receiving 600 000 tokens for this 5000 euro out of this five thousand euro people got in the end of the day if they were mining the coin using the promotion and so on about 40 000 to 50 000 coins. But some of you have also made a lot of coins with bonuses. So I would say, whoever mines immediately with his coins, according to my calculation 48 000 coins x 1 euro is about 50 000 euros. Not bad! not bad. Where will Oneco be in one year? The same answer, as always, I don't know, nobody knows, but I think we have been doing extremely well, and to my view, we are moving much more towards an optimistic scenario than towards the base scenario. Of course it depends on the people mining the coin. It depends on the demand and of you but I think until now we are doing extremely well and I would like to thank everyone here for supporting our coin mining coin, mining it and making it more and more popular every day. Now as I said some of us made quite a good return on the investment but I assume if you want to continue doing this and also our new members want to make a very good return, how do you make this coin very very big yes thank you very much this is the first part of my presentation um i will be back and now there's something special coming up for the stage thank you very much everybody There's something special coming up for the stage. Thank you very much. Everybody!
